premises.text: Personal computing interfaces should be tailored to the individual rather than a single solution for all users
premises.evidence_span: Imagine a world of personal computing interfaces tailored to the individual as opposed to a single solution needing to appease two billion users

premises.text: Current operating systems create confusion and inefficiency for users
premises.evidence_span: Recall a time when you couldn't put your hand on a specific document that you knew was there, your desktop was overloaded with Windows, or your mother called you frantically because she couldn't figure out how to log off from her computer

premises.text: A system with workspaces and built-in cloud synchronization can improve user experience
premises.evidence_span: Imagine a system with workspaces, built-in cloud synchronization, SQL on the desktop with natural language processing assistance

premises.text: Lumiere enhances existing operating systems rather than replacing them
premises.evidence_span: What we're suggesting is not a replacement for any sort of operating system. Rather to embrace, extend, and enhance the system of choice of two billion people

premises.text: A clean delineation of workspaces can help users manage their tasks more effectively
premises.evidence_span: we have a clean delineation of these spaces so you can understand sort them yourself by pulling them around

premises.text: Innovation in the industry requires collaboration among domain experts
premises.evidence_span: Currently, much innovation that occurs that occurs in the industry requires a large amount of varied opinions to agree with each other

value.text: Users can experience a more intuitive and efficient computing environment
value.evidence_span: to create a pace of rapid innovation to deliver some things that people, frankly, never been able to see before
